Moreover, the entire distal bowel is filled with contrast and the rectum appears convex shaped and adequately distended. a has been suggested by Halleran et al ( Fig. 3 ). 3 The right arm can be used to represent the course of the male urethra: with the elbow representing the bulbar urethra, the humerus representing the prostatic urethra, and the axilla representing the bladder neck.
